title: Assume
scene: A middle-school student looks at a silent phone and folds their free arm across their body. Above them, a simple outlined thought bubble contains a small neutral friend's face with turned-away eyes. A small CLOSED padlock attached to the edge of the thought bubble is a conceptual symbol for treating a guess as settled. Make the phone blank and the imagined face clearly inside the bubble. Not angry, just prematurely certain. Exactly two anatomically correct arms and hands.
alt: A student looks at a silent phone while a thought bubble shows a friend looking away; a closed padlock on the bubble symbolizes treating the guess as settled.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square glossary illustration for a middle-school Crew SEL pack. Style: warm simple flat illustration with muted earth colors, clean uncluttered shapes, softly textured paper and respectful expressions. Fictional diverse students ages 12 to 14. No words, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos or watermarks. Every person must have exactly two naturally attached arms and coherent hair.
